SELECT s.id AS id, s.number AS serialNumber, s.state AS state, s.warehouse AS warehouseId, s.goods AS goodsId, s.batch AS batchId, s.room AS roomId, g.name AS goodsName, g.number AS goodsNumber, g.spec AS goodsSpec, w.name AS warehouseName FROM serial s LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = s.goods LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse
AND s.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber}, '%')
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsName}, '%')
AND g.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{goodsNumber}, '%')
AND s.warehouse = #{warehouseId}
AND s.state = #{state}
ORDER BY s.id DESC
